utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—I'm still waiting on the tool list, then I can swing by and see what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the tool list is still coming, sorry. I just remember the gate and a couple lane markers need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s happening. Start at the first repair drive location and let me know what tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely happening — Saturday morning at the community center on Maple. I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m still aiming for Saturday morning at the community center on Maple, and I’ll let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — Saturday morning at the community center on Maple works for me. Let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Eli — we’re still nailing down the details, but your help would be great for setup this afternoon. I’ll send the exact time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got it: the driveway crack and the loose section by the gate. I’ll let you know when I can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — that sounds like the right scope. Just send me the time, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send them my way, and I’ll help connect everyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — I’ll start spreading the word right away and send any volunteers your way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly tools and a few hands to sort donations fast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort donations—what tools are we short on most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check what tools we’re still missing for the repair drive and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Pia — I’m still catching up, so your update would help a lot. If you hear the first location, could you let me know that too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’m still trying to remember the first repair drive spot. If you know it, could you point me there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’m checking the list now and I’ll let you know which tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. Tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m still gathering the rest of the details, but that’s the main update for now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know if you need any help once the details come together.
